verse.unicode: ਚਵਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਅੰਬਰੀਕ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਿਆ ॥

en.bdb: The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of supernatural spiritual powers, and the Buddhas are imbued with the Naam; it carried Ambreek across the terrifying world-ocean.
en.ms: The eighty-four men of miracles and Budhas are imbued with the Name, by which Ambrik was ferried across the dreadful world ocean.
en.ssk: The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of supernatural spiritual powers, and the Buddhas are imbued with the Naam; it carried Ambreek across the terrifying world-ocean.

es.sn: Los ochenta y cuatro Siddhas, los que tienen poderes sobrenaturales, los Buddas, están embebidos con el Naam, llevó a Ambrik a través del aterrador océano del mundo.

en.bdb: It has erased the sins of Oodho, Akroor, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
en.ms: The Name effaced the sins of Oodho, Akrur and, in the Darkage, of Tirlochan, Nam Dev and Kabir.
en.ssk: It has erased the sins of Oodho, Akroor, Trilochan, Naam Dayv and Kabeer, in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga.

es.sn: Ha borrado las faltas de Odho, Akur, Trilochan, Nam Dev y Kabir en esta era oscura de Kali.

verse.gurmukhi: soeI nwmu AClu Bgqh Bv qwrxu Amrdws gur kau PuirAw ]3]
verse.unicode: ਸੋਈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਛਲੁ ਭਗਤਹ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਣੁ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਫੁਰਿਆ ॥੩॥

en.bdb: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||3||
en.ms: The very same Undeceivable Name, which ferries the saints across the world ocean, came into the mind of Guru Amar Dass.
en.ssk: That Undeceivable Naam, which carries the devotees across the world-ocean, came into Guru Amar Daas. ||3||

en.bdb: The three hundred thirty million angels meditate, attached to the Naam; it is enshrined within the minds of the celibates and ascetics.
en.ms: To that very Name are attached thirty-three millions of angles who remember it ever and it is also enshrined within the mind of the celibates and penitents.
en.ssk: The three hundred thirty million angels meditate, attached to the Naam; it is enshrined within the minds of the celibates and ascetics.

es.sn: Los trescientos treinta ángeles meditan, apegados al Naam, también ha sido enaltecido en las mentes de los célibes y ascetas.

transliteration.en: tit naam laag tetees dhiaaveh jatee tapeesur man vasiaa ||

en.bdb: Bhisham Pitama, the son of the Ganges, meditated on that Naam; his consciousness delighted in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Feet.
en.ms: Meditating on that very Name, the Ganga's son, Bhisham Pitama, enjoyed in his mind the ambrosia of the Lord's feet.
en.ssk: Bhisham Pitama, the son of the Ganges, meditated on that Naam; his consciousness delighted in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Feet.

es.sn: El Naam da soporte a los sistemas solares y a las galaxias.

en.bdb: The Naam is the most sublime of all; the devotees remain lovingly attuned to it.
en.ms: Amongst all the things, the Name is the most sublime. The saints remain attuned to it.
en.ssk: The Naam is the most sublime of all; the devotees remain lovingly attuned to it.

es.sn: Quien medita en el Naam en Samadhi, siente el placer y el dolor como uno y lo mismo.

en.bdb: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the treasure of the Naam, by the Creator Lord, in His Pleasure. ||6||
en.ms: With that very wealth of the Name, the Creator-Lord has blessed Guru Amar Dass is His pleasure.
en.ssk: Guru Amar Daas was blessed with the treasure of the Naam, by the Creator Lord, in His Pleasure. ||6||

es.sn: El Naam es lo más Sublime de todo, los Devotos permanecen amorosamente entonados en Él.

verse.unicode: ਸਤਿ ਸੂਰਉ ਸੀਲਿ ਬਲਵੰਤੁ ਸਤ ਭਾਇ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਘਨ ਗਰੂਅ ਮਤਿ ਨਿਰਵੈਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ॥

en.bdb: He is the Warrior Hero of Truth, humility is His Power. His Loving Nature inspires the Congregation with deep and profound understanding; He is absorbed in the Lord, free of hate and vengeance.
en.ms: The Guru is the hero of truth, powerful in humility, good-tempered and remains in the great congregation of profound understanding, absorbed in the Uninimical Lord.
en.ssk: He is the Warrior Hero of Truth, humility is His Power. His Loving Nature inspires the Congregation with deep and profound understanding; He is absorbed in the Lord, free of hate and vengeance.

es.sn: Guru Amar Das fue Bendecido con el Tesoro del Naam, por el sólo Placer del Señor Creador. (6)

en.bdb: Patience has been His white banner since the beginning of time, planted on the bridge to heaven.
en.ms: Such is the Guru, whose white standard of fortitude is seen on the bridge to the Lord's realm since the very beginning.
en.ssk: Patience has been His white banner since the beginning of time, planted on the bridge to heaven.

es.sn: Él es el Héroe Guerrero de la Verdad, la Humildad es Su Poder, Su Adorable Naturaleza inspira a la Congregación con profundo Entendimiento. Él está absorbido en el Señor, libre de odios y venganzas.

es.sn: La Paciencia ha sido Su Blanco, Estandarte desde el principio de los tiempos plantado en el Puente a los Cielos.

verse.unicode: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਅਮਰਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਤਉ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੭॥

en.bdb: Serving the True Guru, they find peace; Guru Amar Daas has given them this ability. ||7||
en.ms: Serving the True Guru, the saints obtain peace and Guru Amar Dass enables them to attain peace.
en.ssk: Serving the True Guru, they find peace; Guru Amar Daas has given them this ability. ||7||

es.sn: Los Santos encuentran a su Bienamado Guru, Quien está unido a Su Señor Creador; sirviendo al Verdadero Guru encuentra la Paz. Guru Amar Das le ha dado esta habilidad. (7)

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸ ਖਾਣੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਯ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਸ੍ਟ ਬਾਣੀ ॥

en.bdb: The Naam is His cleansing bath; the Naam is the food He eats; the Naam is the taste He enjoys. With deep yearning, He chants the Sweet Bani of the Guru's Word forever.
en.ms: The Name is the Guru's ablution, the Name his partaking of the dainties and the Name his relish of victuals and with his mouth, he ever yearningly recites the sweet world of the Guru.
en.ssk: The Naam is His cleansing bath; the Naam is the food He eats; the Naam is the taste He enjoys. With deep yearning, He chants the Sweet Bani of the Guru's Word forever.

es.sn: El Naam es su baño purificador, es el alimento que come y el Sabor que disfruta con una gran añoranza, cantando el Dulce Bani de la Palabra del Guru para siempre.

en.bdb: Blessed is service to the True Guru; by His Grace, the State of the Unfathomable Lord is known.
en.ms: Thou have served the blessed True Guru, by whose grace, thou have realised the state of the Unintelligible Lord.
en.ssk: Blessed is service to the True Guru; by His Grace, the State of the Unfathomable Lord is known.

es.sn: Concientemente rezo, pero no lo puedo expresar en palabras, he puesto todas mis ansiedades y preocupaciones ante Ti y voy a la Saad Sangat, la Compañía de los Santos a pedir ayuda.

en.bdb: I place all my worries and anxieties before You; I look to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, for help.
en.ms: I leave all my care to thee and look to the saints congregation for help.
en.ssk: I place all my worries and anxieties before You; I look to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, for help.

es.sn: Por el Jukam, el Mandato de Tu Voluntad, soy bendecido con Tu Insignia y así sirvo a mi Señor y Maestro.

en.bdb: By the Hukam of Your Command, I am blessed with Your Insignia; I serve my Lord and Master.
en.ms: In thy will, I am blessed with the stamp of thy mercy and then serve I my Lord.
en.ssk: By the Hukam of Your Command, I am blessed with Your Insignia; I serve my Lord and Master.

es.sn: Cuando me ves, oh Guru, con tu Mirada de Gracia, el Fruto del Naam es puesto sobre mis labios.

en.bdb: When You, O Guru, gaze at me with Your Glance of Grace, the fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Creator, is placed within my mouth.
en.ms: When, O Guru, thou see me with the propitious glance, then the fruit of the Creator's Name is in my mouth.
en.ssk: When You, O Guru, gaze at me with Your Glance of Grace, the fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Creator, is placed within my mouth.

es.sn: Así como el Insondable, Invisible y Primordial Dios nuestro Señor, la Causa de causas, ordena, así hablo yo.

en.bdb: The Unfathomable and Unseen Primal Lord God, the Cause of causes - as He orders, so do I speak.
en.ms: Whatever is the command of the Unfathomable and Unseen Lord, who is the cause of all causes, that alone I recite.
en.ssk: The Unfathomable and Unseen Primal Lord God, the Cause of causes - as He orders, so do I speak.

es.sn: Oh Guru Amar Das, el Hacedor, la Causa de causas, así como Tú me conservas yo permanezco,

en.bdb: O Guru Amar Daas, Doer of deeds, Cause of causes, as You keep me, I remain; as You protect me, I survive. ||4||18||
en.ms: O Guru Amar Dass, thou are the doer of all deeds; as thou keep me, so do I live.
en.ssk: O Guru Amar Daas, Doer of deeds, Cause of causes, as You keep me, I remain; as You protect me, I survive. ||4||18||

en.ssk: He is fearless in the Fear of the Eternal Lord God; He has thrust the spear of the Word of the Guru's Shabad into the mind.

en.bdb: Guru Amar Daas, the son of Tayj Bhaan, of the noble Bhalla dynasty, blessed by Guru Nanak, is the Master of kings.
en.ms: Guru Amar Dass, the son of Tej Bhan, is the supreme person in the dynasty of Bhallas. Through the blessings of Guru Nanak, he is now the king of kings.
en.ssk: Guru Amar Daas, the son of Tayj Bhaan, of the noble Bhalla dynasty, blessed by Guru Nanak, is the Master of kings.

en.ms: No one can count the rain drops falling from the clouds, the vegetation of the earth or the flowers of the spring.
en.ssk: The raindrops of the clouds, the plants of the earth, and the flowers of the spring cannot be counted.

es.sn: la Palabra de Dios, el Naam Inmaculado ha sido enaltecido en su corazón.

en.bdb: He served the True Guru and was blessed with the sublime essence of the Shabad, the Word of God. The Immaculate Naam has been enshrined in his heart.
en.ms: Serving Amar Dass, the True Guru, that Guru Ram Dass was blessed with the Lord's elixir and he enshrined the immaculate Name in his mind.
en.ssk: He served the True Guru and was blessed with the sublime essence of the Shabad, the Word of God. The Immaculate Naam has been enshrined in his heart.

es.sn: Él disfruta y saborea el Nombre del Señor, y compra las Gloriosas Virtudes del Señor del Universo.

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿਕੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਚਾਹਕੁ ਤਤ ਸਮਤ ਸਰੇ ॥

en.bdb: He enjoys and savors the Lord's Name, and purchases the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe. He seeks the essence of reality; he is the Fountain of even-handed justice.
en.ms: Guru Ram Dass is the enjoyer of the God's Name, the purchaser of the Lord's virtues, the seeker of the Master's quintessence and the fountain of even-handed justice.
en.ssk: He enjoys and savors the Lord's Name, and purchases the Glorious Virtues of the Lord of the Universe. He seeks the essence of reality; he is the Fountain of even-handed justice.

es.sn: Él busca la Esencia de la Realidad y es la Fuente de toda Justicia impartida.

en.bdb: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||1||
en.ms: Says Kalsahar, the bard, Guru Ram Dass, the son of Thankar Har Dass, fills the empty tanks.
en.ssk: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||1||

es.sn: Así dice Kal el poeta, Guru Ram Das, hijo de Jar Das, llena los lagos vacíos hasta derramarlos. (1)

verse.unicode: ਛੁਟਤ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਅਮਿਅ ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਸਦ ਭਰਿਆ ॥

en.bdb: The stream of ambrosial nectar flows and the immortal status is obtained; the pool is forever overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.
en.ms: From Guru Ram Dass proceeds the stream of Nectar and immortal status, and he is like a tank of ambrosia that is always filled up to brim.
en.ssk: The stream of ambrosial nectar flows and the immortal status is obtained; the pool is forever overflowing with Ambrosial Nectar.

es.sn: El flujo del Néctar Ambrosial fluye y la Inmortalidad es obtenida, el lago está para siempre derramando Néctar Ambrosial.

verse.unicode: ਤੇ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਮਜਨੁ ਪੁਬ ਜਿਨਹੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀਆ ॥

en.bdb: Those Saints who have served the Lord in the past drink in this Nectar, and bathe their minds in it.
en.ms: Only those saints in-drink this nectar and bathe their mind in it, who have served their Lord in the past.
en.ssk: Those Saints who have served the Lord in the past drink in this Nectar, and bathe their minds in it.

es.sn: Los Santos que han servido al Señor en el pasado, beben de éste Néctar y bañan su mente en Él.

transliteration.hi: ते पीवहि संत करहि मनि मजनु पुब जिनहु सेवा करीआ ॥
transliteration.ipa: t̪e piʋəh səŋt̪ kərəh mən məd͡ʒən pʊb d͡ʒɪnəh seʋɑ kəriəɑ.

verse.unicode: ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਅਨਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਦੀਨਾ ਸਬਦ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਤੇ ਉਧਰ ਧਰੇ ॥

en.bdb: God takes their fears away, and blesses them with the state of fearless dignity. Through the Word of His Shabad, He has saved them.
en.ms: The Lord drives away their fear, blesses them with the fearless status and ferries them across through His name alone.
en.ssk: God takes their fears away, and blesses them with the state of fearless dignity. Through the Word of His Shabad, He has saved them.

es.sn: Dios remueve sus miedos y los bendice con el Estado de Dignidad sin miedos, a través de la Palabra de Su Shabd, los ha salvado.

transliteration.ur: تٍن بھا نوار انبھَے پد دیٍنا سبد ماتر تے اُدھر دھرے ۔۔

verse.unicode: ਕਵਿ ਕਲੵ ਠਕੁਰ ਹਰਦਾਸ ਤਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸਰ ਅਭਰ ਭਰੇ ॥੨॥

en.bdb: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||2||
en.ms: Says Kalsahar, the bard, Guru Ram Dass, the son of the Thakar Har Dass, fills the empty tanks.
en.ssk: So speaks KALL the poet: Guru Raam Daas, the son of Har Daas, fills the empty pools to overflowing. ||2||

es.sn: Así dice Kal el poeta, Guru Ram Das, el hijo de Jar Das, llena los lagos vacíos hasta derramarlos. (2)

transliteration.english: kav kalaye Thakur haradhaas tane gur raamadhaas sar abhar bhare ||2||
transliteration.hindi: कवि कल्य ठकुर हरदास तने गुर रामदास सर अभर भरे ॥२॥
transliteration.en: kav kalaye Thakur haradhaas tane gur raamadhaas sar abhar bhare ||2||

transliteration.ipa: kəʋ kələj ʈʰəkʊr hərəd̪ɑs t̪əne Gʊr rɑməd̪ɑs sər əɓər ɓəre.2.
transliteration.ur: کو کلے ٹھکر هرداس تنے گُر رامداس سر ابھر بھرے ۔۔۲۔۔

verse.unicode: ਸਤਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਗੂੜੑ ਬਿਮਲ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੁ ਭਯਾ ॥

en.bdb: The True Guru's understanding is deep and profound. The Sat Sangat is His Pure Congregation. His Soul is drenched in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.
en.ms: Profound is the True Guru's understanding, his association makes man blotless and his soul is imbued deep red with the love of his Lord.
en.ssk: The True Guru's understanding is deep and profound. The Sat Sangat is His Pure Congregation. His Soul is drenched in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love.

en.bdb: The Lotus of His mind remains awake and aware, illuminated with intuitive wisdom. In His own home, He has obtained the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.
en.ms: Illumined with Divine knowledge, his mind lotus remains awake and in his very home he has attained the fear-free immaculate Lord.
en.ssk: The Lotus of His mind remains awake and aware, illuminated with intuitive wisdom. In His own home, He has obtained the Fearless, Immaculate Lord.

es.sn: El Loto de su mente permanece despierto y conciente, iluminado con la Sabiduría Intuitiva, en su propio hogar, ha obtenido al Inmaculado e Intrépido Señor.

en.bdb: The Merciful True Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me, and by His Grace, I have overpowered the five thieves.
en.ms: The merciful True Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me and by his grace, I have disciplined the five demons.
en.ssk: The Merciful True Guru has implanted the Lord's Name within me, and by His Grace, I have overpowered the five thieves.

es.sn: El Señor Creador avaló al Guru, y ahora el mundo entero toca las Trompetas de Su Alabanza.

en.ms: Says Kall, thou, O Guru Ram Dass, has obtained the eternal and Imperishable status.
en.ssk: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the state of fearless immortality. ||6||

es.sn: Así dice Kal el poeta, Guru Ram Das, has obtenido el Estado de la Inmortalidad sin miedos. (6)

en.ms: O approved True Guru, thou have conquered the world and thou contemplate the One Lord in thy mind.
en.ssk: O certified True Guru, You have conquered the world; You meditate single-mindedly on the One Lord.

es.sn: Oh, Aprobado y Verdadero Guru, has conquistado el mundo entero, Tú meditas con una mente Sencilla en el Señor. Bendito, Bendito sea Guru Amar Das, el Verdadero Guru, Quien implantó el Naam, en lo profundo del interior.

en.ms: Blest, blest is Amar Dass, the True Guru, who has enshrined the Name within him.
en.ssk: Blessed, blessed is Guru Amar Daas, the True Guru, who implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, deep within.

es.sn: El Naam es la Riqueza de los Nueve Tesoros, la Prosperidad y los Poderes Espirituales Sobrenaturales son Sus Esclavos.

en.ssk: The Naam is the wealth of the nine treasures; prosperity and supernatural spiritual powers are His slaves.

en.ssk: He is blessed with the ocean of intuitive wisdom; He has met with the Imperishable Lord God.

es.sn: La Sabiduría es Su Madre, el Contentamiento es el Padre, y Él vive absorbido en el Océano de Paz y Tranquilidad Intuitiva.

verse.unicode: ਆਜੋਨੀ ਸੰਭਵਿਅਉ ਜਗਤੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਤਰਾਯਉ ॥

en.bdb: The Guru is the Embodiment of the Unborn, Self-illumined Lord; by the Word of His Teachings, the Guru carries the world across.
en.ms: The Guru is the embodiment of the unborn and self-illumined Lord and by his word ferries the world across.
en.ssk: The Guru is the Embodiment of the Unborn, Self-illumined Lord; by the Word of His Teachings, the Guru carries the world across.

es.sn: El Guru es la Esencia del Señor, Nonato y Auto Iluminado, por la Palabra de Sus Enseñanzas,

en.bdb: Within His mind, the Guru has enshrined the Shabad, the Word of the Unseen, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord.
en.ms: Within his mind, the Guru has enshrined the Name of the Unseen and Unapprehensible Transcendent Lord.
en.ssk: Within His mind, the Guru has enshrined the Shabad, the Word of the Unseen, Unfathomable, Infinite Lord.

en.bdb: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the Lord, the Saving Grace of the world. ||8||
en.ms: Says Kall, O Guru Ram Dass, thou have attained unto God, the Saviour of the world.
en.ssk: So speaks KALL: O Guru Raam Daas, You have attained the Lord, the Saving Grace of the world. ||8||

es.sn: Insondable e Infinito Señor. Así dice Kal el poeta, Guru Ram Das, has obtenido al Señor, la Gracia Salvadora del mundo. (8)

en.bdb: The Saving Grace of the world, the nine treasures, carries the devotees across the world-ocean.
en.ms: God's Name is the Deliverer of the universe, the Giver of nine treasures and ferries the saints across the world ocean.
en.ssk: The Saving Grace of the world, the nine treasures, carries the devotees across the world-ocean.

en.bdb: The Guru is the Giver to all beings; He speaks the spiritual wisdom of the Unfathomable Lord, and meditates on Him day and night. He never sleeps, even for an instant.
en.ms: The Guru is the blesser of all the beings, recites the gnosis of the Unfathomable Lord, e ver contemplates Him and sleeps not even for a while.
en.ssk: The Guru is the Giver to all beings; He speaks the spiritual wisdom of the Unfathomable Lord, and meditates on Him day and night. He never sleeps, even for an instant.

es.sn: El Guru es el Dador de todos los seres, Él pronuncia la Sabiduría Espiritual del Insondable Señor y medita en Él noche y día. Él no duerme ni por un instante.

en.bdb: Seeing Him, poverty vanishes, and one is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The spiritual wisdom of the Guru's Word washes away the filth of evil-mindedness.
en.ms: Such is the Guru, seeing whom poverty vanishes and one is blessed with the Name-like treasure. The Divine knowledge imparted by the supreme Guru washed off the filth of the evil-intellect.
en.ssk: Seeing Him, poverty vanishes, and one is blessed with the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. The spiritual wisdom of the Guru's Word washes away the filth of evil-mindedness.

es.sn: Viéndolo, la pobreza desaparece y uno es bendecido con el Tesoro, el Nombre del Señor. La Sabiduría Espiritual del Guru lava la mugre de la mentalidad malvada.

en.bdb: Tell me, how can sin and suffering cling to that humble being who chants the Naam, given by the Guru, with single-minded love and firm faith? ||1||
en.ms: How can suffering and sin cling to that person who steadfastly recites the Name with love and focused mint that is given by the True Guru?

en.ms: Faith and good deeds are obtained from the perfect True Guru.
en.ssk: Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect True Guru.

verse.unicode: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਜਾਚਹਿ ਸਬਦ ਸਾਰੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਹੈ ॥

en.bdb: The Siddhas and Holy Saadhus, the silent sages and angelic beings, yearn to serve Him; through the most excellent Word of the Shabad, they are lovingly attuned to the One Lord.
en.ms: Such is the Lord, for whose service crave the adepts, saints, silent sages and the angelic persons and through whose sublime Name, man is attuned to the One God.
en.ssk: The Siddhas and Holy Saadhus, the silent sages and angelic beings, yearn to serve Him; through the most excellent Word of the Shabad, they are lovingly attuned to the One Lord.

verse.unicode: ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਨਹਾਰੁ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਹੈ ॥

en.bdb: Who can know Your limits? You are the Embodiment of the Fearless, Formless Lord. You are the Speaker of the Unspoken Speech; You alone understand this.
en.ms: Again, who can know thy limit, O Guru? Thou are the embodiment of the Fear-free and Formless Lord. Thou alone describe the Ineffable God and thou alone are blessed with His comprehension.
en.ssk: Who can know Your limits? You are the Embodiment of the Fearless, Formless Lord. You are the Speaker of the Unspoken Speech; You alone understand this.

en.bdb: O foolish worldly mortal, you are deluded by doubt; give up birth and death, and you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death. Meditate on the Guru's Teachings.
en.ms: O worldly doubt-strayed man lost in doubt, reflect thou on thy Lord by the Guru's instruction. Thiswise thou shall be delivered of birth and death and the death's courier shall punish thee not.
en.ssk: O foolish worldly mortal, you are deluded by doubt; give up birth and death, and you shall not be punished by the Messenger of Death. Meditate on the Guru's Teachings.

es.sn: Oh Tonto mortal mundano, vive engañado por la duda, deja el nacimiento y la muerte y no tendrás que enfrentar al mensajero de la muerte. Medita en las Enseñanzas del Guru.

verse.unicode: ਮਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਮੁਗਧ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਪੁ ਧਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੨॥

en.bdb: You foolish mortal being, reflect on this in your mind; chant and meditate day and night. Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect True Guru. ||2||
en.ms: O silly mortal, reflect, reflect thou in thy mind and, day and night, recite thou, thy Lord's Name. Faith and good deed are obtained from the perfect True Guru.
en.ssk: You foolish mortal being, reflect on this in your mind; chant and meditate day and night. Dharmic faith and the karma of good deeds are obtained from the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

es.sn: Oh tonto mortal, medita en esto en tu mente, día y noche, la Fe en el Dharma y el Karma de las buenas acciones se obtienen del Perfecto y Verdadero Guru. (2)

en.bdb: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru.
en.ms: O my True Guru, I am a sacrifice, yea, O sacrifice unto True Name.
en.ssk: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru.

verse.unicode: ਕਵਨ ਉਪਮਾ ਦੇਉ ਕਵਨ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਰੇਉ ਏਕ ਮੁਖ ਰਸਨਾ ਰਸਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਰਿ ਕਰ ॥

en.bdb: What Praises can I offer to You? What service can I do for You? I have only one mouth and tongue; with my palms pressed together, I chant to You with joy and delight.
en.ms: What praise can I attribute unto thee and what service of thine can I perform with the one tongue of my mouth, I joyful recite thy Name clasping both of my hands.
en.ssk: What Praises can I offer to You? What service can I do for You? I have only one mouth and tongue; with my palms pressed together, I chant to You with joy and delight.

es.sn: ¿Qué Alabanzas te puedo ofrecer?, ¿qué Servicio te puedo ofrecer?, sólo tengo unos labios y una lengua, con mis palmas juntas, Te canto con Dicha y Gozo.

verse.unicode: ਫੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਜਾਨੁ ਅਨਤ ਦੂਜਾ ਨ ਮਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੋ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਿਦ ਧਰ ॥

en.bdb: In thought, word and deed, I know the Lord; I do not worship any other. The Guru has enshrined the most excellent Name of the Infinite Lord within my heart.
en.ms: Again, in thy thought, word and deed, thou realise the True Name and adore not any other. O Guru, thou have enshrined within my mind the sublime Name of the Infinite Lord.
en.ssk: In thought, word and deed, I know the Lord; I do not worship any other. The Guru has enshrined the most excellent Name of the Infinite Lord within my heart.

es.sn: En pensamiento, palabra y obra, conozco al Señor y no alabo a ningún otro. El Guru ha enaltecido al más Excelente Nombre del Infinito Señor en mi corazón.

verse.unicode: ਨਲੵ ਕਵਿ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸ ਕਚ ਕੰਚਨਾ ਹੁਇ ਚੰਦਨਾ ਸੁਬਾਸੁ ਜਾਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਅਨ ਤਰ ॥

en.bdb: So speaks NALL the poet: touching the Philosopher's Stone, glass is transformed into gold, and the sandalwood tree imparts its fragrance to other trees; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am transformed.
en.ms: Says Nall, the poet, just as by touching philosopher's stone, glass becomes gold and just as sandal imparts fragrance to other trees, similar is the Guru, whose contemplation transmutes the mortal.
en.ssk: So speaks NALL the poet: touching the Philosopher's Stone, glass is transformed into gold, and the sandalwood tree imparts its fragrance to other trees; meditating in remembrance on the Lord, I am transformed.

es.sn: Habla entonces Kal, el poeta, tocando la Piedra Filosofal, el vidrio es transformado en oro, y el árbol de Sándalo impregna su aroma a otros árboles, meditando en el Señor, soy transformado.

en.bdb: Seeing His Door, I am rid of sexual desire and anger. I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, to the True Name, O my True Guru. ||3||
en.ms: I am a sacrifice yea, a sacrifice unto the True Name of the True Guru, seeing whose door, one is rid of lust and wrath.

en.bdb: First, Guru Nanak illuminated the world, like the full moon, and filled it with bliss. To carry humanity across, He bestowed His Radiance.
en.ms: As first Nanak Dev became manifest like the moon. To emancipate the human beings, he illumined the world, which was then filled with bliss.

en.bdb: He blessed Guru Angad with the treasure of spiritual wisdom, and the Unspoken Speech; He overcame the five demons and the fear of the Messenger of Death.
en.ms: With the treasure of the Divine discourse and gnosis of the Ineffable Lord, Nanak blessed Guru Angad, who overcame his five demos and was rid of the fear of the Death's courier.
en.ssk: He blessed Guru Angad with the treasure of spiritual wisdom, and the Unspoken Speech; He overcame the five demons and the fear of the Messenger of Death.

en.bdb: The Great and True Guru, Guru Amar Daas, has preserved honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. Seeing His Lotus Feet, sin and evil are destroyed.
en.ms: The great and venerable True Guru, Amar Dass saved the honour of the Darkage and such is he, seeing whose lotus feet, men's sins are destroyed.
en.ssk: The Great and True Guru, Guru Amar Daas, has preserved honor in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. Seeing His Lotus Feet, sin and evil are destroyed.

en.ssk: Without the Guru, there is no intuitive awareness or success; without the Guru, there is no liberation.

en.ssk: Make Him your Guru, who is embellished and exalted in the Word of the Shabad; all your sins shall be washed away.

es.sn: Él es el Héroe Espiritual, Quien destruye el dolor y trae la Paz. Quien sea que medite en Él, habita en él, Él es el Perfecto Ser Primordial.

en.bdb: He is the Perfect Primal Being, who meditates in remembrance on the Lord within his heart; seeing His Face, sins run away.
en.ms: The Guru is the perfect person, who remembers Lord in the mind. Seeing the face of such a Guru, the sins are washed away.
en.ssk: He is the Perfect Primal Being, who meditates in remembrance on the Lord within his heart; seeing His Face, sins run away.

en.bdb: So speaks the Lord's slave: Guru Raam Daas placed His Faith in Guru Amar Daas, the Guru of the World; touching the Philosopher's Stone, He was transformed into the Philosopher's Stone.
en.ms: Says the Guru's slave that the Guru (Ram Dass) leaned on the world-teacher, Guru Amar Dass, who uniting him with the philosopher's stone, has made him the philosopher's stone.
en.ssk: So speaks the Lord's slave: Guru Raam Daas placed His Faith in Guru Amar Daas, the Guru of the World; touching the Philosopher's Stone, He was transformed into the Philosopher's Stone.

en.bdb: Then, you shall obtain His Love and Affection; become Gurmukh, and meditate on Him. Give up all other ways; vibrate and meditate on Him, O spiritual people.
en.ms: Again, O divines, be blessed with the Lord's love and affection and, abandoning other ways, remember and contemplate your God, through the supreme Guru.

verse.unicode: ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਰਿਦਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਪੰਚ ਭੂ ਬਸਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਰਹੁ ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਅਹੁ ॥

en.bdb: Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart, and overpower the five passions. Your life, and your generations, shall be saved, and you shall be honored at the Lord's Door.
en.ms: Enshrine the Lord's Name in your mind, overwhelm your heart of five elements and save your life and lineage. This wise you shall be honoured in the Lord's Court.
en.ssk: Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart, and overpower the five passions. Your life, and your generations, shall be saved, and you shall be honored at the Lord's Door.

verse.unicode: ਅਗਮ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਧਰਹੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਚਨ ਗੁਰ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਰਿ ॥

en.bdb: Know that the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Enshrine Him in your mind, and meditate on Him. Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart.
en.ms: Know thou that God is the infinite treasure of virtues. So contemplate Him in the mind and, day and night. rcite and enshrine the Guru's word in thy heart.
en.ssk: Know that the Lord is the Treasure of Excellence. Enshrine Him in your mind, and meditate on Him. Enshrine the Word of the Guru's Teachings within your heart.

verse.unicode: ਫੁਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਲ ਬਿਮਲ ਅਥਾਹ ਮਜਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਤਰਹੁ ਨਾਮ ਸਚ ਰੰਗ ਸਰਿ ॥

en.bdb: Then, cleanse yourself in the Immaculate and Unfathomable Water of the Guru; O Gursikhs and Saints, cross over the Ocean of Love of the True Name.
en.ms: Then take ye bath in the Guru's immaculate and unfathomable water and swim about in the love-ocean of the True Name, O saints and Guru's disciples.
en.ssk: Then, cleanse yourself in the Immaculate and Unfathomable Water of the Guru; O Gursikhs and Saints, cross over the Ocean of Love of the True Name.

verse.unicode: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਜਪੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਰਸਿ ਕਰਤ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ॥

en.bdb: Meditate lovingly forever on the Lord, free of hate and vengeance, Formless and Fearless; lovingly savor the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and implant devotional worship of the Lord deep within.
en.ms: The Guru ever lovingly meditates on the Envy-free, Formless and Fear-free Lord and with relish grasps God's Name and devotion.
en.ssk: Meditate lovingly forever on the Lord, free of hate and vengeance, Formless and Fearless; lovingly savor the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and implant devotional worship of the Lord deep within.

es.sn: Mediten amorosamente y para siempre en el Señor, Libre de odios y venganzas, Sin Forma y Sin Miedo, amorosamente saboreen la Palabra del Shabd del Guru e implanten la Alabanza de Devoción en lo profundo de su interior.

verse.unicode: ਮੁਗਧ ਮਨ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਜਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਜਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੪॥

en.bdb: O foolish mind, give up your doubts; as Gurmukh, vibrate and meditate on the Naam. Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, and know Him as true. ||2||14||
en.ms: O my foolish mind, discard thy doubt and recite the Name by the Guru's grace, Deeming Him as true, meditate thou on thy God, the great Teacher, the Teacher of the teacher.
en.ssk: O foolish mind, give up your doubts; as Gurmukh, vibrate and meditate on the Naam. Chant Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, Guru, and know Him as true. ||2||14||

verse.unicode: ਉਦਧਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨਗ ਹੀਰ ਮਣਿ ਮਿਲਤ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈਐ ॥

en.bdb: The Guru is an Ocean, deep and profound, infinite and unfathomable. Lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name, you shall be blessed with jewels, diamonds and emeralds.
en.ms: The Guru is like a deep, unshakable and infinite ocean. Attuned to the God's Name, one is blessed with jewels, rubies and emeralds.
en.ssk: The Guru is an Ocean, deep and profound, infinite and unfathomable. Lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name, you shall be blessed with jewels, diamonds and emeralds.

es.sn: Él Guru es un Océano, Hondo y Profundo, Infinito e Insondable, con todo Amor, entónate en el Nombre del Señor y serás bendecido con esa Joya Preciosa.

en.bdb: And, the Guru makes us fragrant and fruitful, and His Touch transforms us into gold. The filth of evil-mindedness is washed away, meditating on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
en.ms: And the Guru makes man fragrant and delightful, his touch transmutes him into gold and dwelling upon the Guru's word, the filth of his evil-intellect is washed off.
en.ssk: And, the Guru makes us fragrant and fruitful, and His Touch transforms us into gold. The filth of evil-mindedness is washed away, meditating on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

es.sn: El Guru nos hace fragantes y fructíferos y Su Toque nos transforma en oro, las impurezas de la maldad de la mente es lavada, meditando en la Palabra del Shabd del Guru.

verse.unicode: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪਰਵਾਹ ਛੁਟਕੰਤ ਸਦ ਦ੍ਵਾਰਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੵਾਨ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਮਲ ਸਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਿਖ ਨਾਈਐ ॥

en.bdb: The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar flows constantly from His Door. The Saints and Sikhs bathe in the immaculate pool of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.
en.ms: Such is the Guru, from whose door ever gushes forth the stream of Nectar and in the immaculate pool of his gnosis bathe the saints and his disciples.
en.ssk: The Stream of Ambrosial Nectar flows constantly from His Door. The Saints and Sikhs bathe in the immaculate pool of the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

en.bdb: Naarad and Sanak and those men of God who became Gurmukh were carried across; attached to the One Name, they abandoned other tastes and pleasures, and were carried across.
en.ms: Abandoning other relishes and attached to the One Name, Narad and his like Sanak etc. and other holy men of God have been saved and emancipated.

en.bdb: The Guru's Darshan is fruitful and rewarding in this world, like the Ganges. Meeting Him, the supreme sacred status is obtained.
en.ms: Says Ganga, the bard, accredited is the vision of the Guru in this world. Meeting with him one is blest with the Immaculate supreme status.
en.ssk: The Guru's Darshan is fruitful and rewarding in this world, like the Ganges. Meeting Him, the supreme sacred status is obtained.

en.bdb: Even sinful people conquer the realm of Death, if they become the Lord's humble servants, and are imbued with the Guru's spiritual wisdom.
en.ms: The sinful persons, who are imbued with the gnosis of the Guru-God, become the Lord's saints and conquer the realm of death.
en.ssk: Even sinful people conquer the realm of Death, if they become the Lord's humble servants, and are imbued with the Guru's spiritual wisdom.

es.sn: Viendo tu Forma Supremamente Bella y escuchando los sonidos musicales de Tus Cascabeles Plateados, se embebió en Dicha.

verse.unicode: ਕਾਲ ਕਲਮ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹਾਥਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਮੇਟਿ ਸਕੈ ਈਸੁ ਬੰਮੵੁ ਗੵਾਨੁ ਧੵਾਨੁ ਧਰਤ ਹੀਐ ਚਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥

en.bdb: Death's pen and command are in Your hands. Tell me, who can erase it? Shiva and Brahma yearn to enshrine Your spiritual wisdom in their hearts.
en.ms: Death's pen and command are in thy hand, and who can efface thy will? Shiva and Brahma crave to enshrine thy gnosis and meditation in their mind.
en.ssk: Death's pen and command are in Your hands. Tell me, who can erase it? Shiva and Brahma yearn to enshrine Your spiritual wisdom in their hearts.

ss.unicode: ਕਾਲ ਦੀ ਕਲਮ ਤੇ ਹੁਕਮ (ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਹੀ) ਹੱਥ ਵਿਚ ਹਨ । ਦੱਸੋ, ਕਉਣ (ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਹੁਕਮ ਨੂੰ) ਮਿਟਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ? ਸ਼ਿਵ ਤੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ (ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੇ ਹੋਏ) ਗਿਆਨ ਤੇ ਧਿਆਨ ਨੂੰ ਆਪਣੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿਚ ਧਾਰਨ ਕਰਨਾ ਚਾਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ ।

es.sn: La pluma de la muerte y el Mandato están bajo tus Manos, dime, ¿quién puede borrarlos? Shiva y Brahma añoran enaltecer Tu Sabiduría Espiritual en su corazón.

verse.unicode: ਸਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥੬॥

en.bdb: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||1||6||
en.ms: Thou are ever just, true, the abode of excellence and the Primeval person. My wondrous, beauteous and lustrious Guru, thou are worthy of praise and reverence.
en.ssk: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||1||6||

es.sn: Eres para siempre Verdad, el Hogar de Excelencia, el Ser Supremo y Primordial, Waje Guru, Waje Guru, Waje Guru, Waje Yio. (1-6)

verse.unicode: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਮ ਧਾਮ ਸੁਧ ਬੁਧ ਨਿਰੀਕਾਰ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਸਰਬਰ ਕਉ ਕਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥

en.bdb: You are blessed with the Lord's Name, the supreme mansion, and clear understanding. You are the Formless, Infinite Lord; who can compare to You?
en.ms: Thou are blessed with the Lord's Name, supreme mansion and clear understanding and thyself are the Formless infinite Lord. Whom should I call equal to thee?
en.ssk: You are blessed with the Lord's Name, the supreme mansion, and clear understanding. You are the Formless, Infinite Lord; who can compare to You?

es.sn: Eres Bendecido con el Nombre del Señor, la Mansión Suprema y el Entendimiento Claro, eres el Señor Infinito y sin Forma. ¿Quién puede compararse a Ti?

en.bdb: For the sake of the pure-hearted devotee Prahlaad, You took the form of the man-lion, to tear apart and destroy Harnaakhash with your claws.
en.ms: For the sake of clean-hearted saint Prahlad, thou assumed the Man-lion from and destroyed and tore Harnakhsh with thy nails.
en.ssk: For the sake of the pure-hearted devotee Prahlaad, You took the form of the man-lion, to tear apart and destroy Harnaakhash with your claws.

es.sn: Sólo por el bien del Devoto Prahlaad tomaste la Forma del hombre león para destrozar a Jarnakash con Tus Garras.

en.bdb: You are the Infinite Supreme Lord God; with your symbols of power, You deceived Baliraja; who can know You?
en.ms: Thou are the Limitless Transcendent Lord, who embellishing thyself with couch, quoit, bludgeon and lotus mark; deceived Ball, the king. Who is that who can know thee (Him)?
en.ssk: You are the Infinite Supreme Lord God; with your symbols of power, You deceived Baliraja; who can know You?

es.sn: Eres el Señor Supremo e infinito, con Tus Símbolos de Poder engañaste a Barilaya. ¿Quién Te podría conocer?

verse.unicode: ਸਤਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿਗੁਰੂ ਵਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥੭॥

en.bdb: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||2||7||
en.ms: O my praiseworthy Lord, God, Master, Thou are ever just, true, the abode of excellence and the Primeval person.
en.ssk: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||2||7||

es.sn: Eres para siempre Verdad, el Hogar de Excelencia, el Ser Supremo y Primordial, Waje Guru, Waje Guru, Waje Guru, Waje Yio. (2-7)

en.bdb: As Krishna, You wear yellow robes, with teeth like jasmine flowers; You dwell with Your lovers, with Your mala around Your neck, and You joyfully adorn Your head with the crow of peacock feathers.
en.ms: Thou wear yellow robe, has teeth like the jasmine flower, abide with thy love, has rosary upon thy neck and eagerly embellish thy head with the crown of the peacock feathers.
en.ssk: As Krishna, You wear yellow robes, with teeth like jasmine flowers; You dwell with Your lovers, with Your mala around Your neck, and You joyfully adorn Your head with the crow of peacock feathers.

verse.unicode: ਬੇਵਜੀਰ ਬਡੇ ਧੀਰ ਧਰਮ ਅੰਗ ਅਲਖ ਅਗਮ ਖੇਲੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਪਣੈ ਉਛਾਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥

en.bdb: You have no advisors, You are so very patient; You are the Upholder of the Dharma, unseen and unfathomable. You have staged the play of the Universe with joy and delight.
en.ms: Thou are without a minister, greatly fortitudinous, partisan of truth, Unseeable and unfathomable, by thy pleasure, thou have staged the world play.
en.ssk: You have no advisors, You are so very patient; You are the Upholder of the Dharma, unseen and unfathomable. You have staged the play of the Universe with joy and delight.

en.bdb: No one can speak Your Unspoken Speech. You are pervading the three worlds. You assume the form of spiritual perfection, O King of kings.
en.ms: O Lord, Thine ineffable discourse can be described not. Thou are pervading the three worlds. O King of kings, thou have naturally assumed the form of the Guru.
en.ssk: No one can speak Your Unspoken Speech. You are pervading the three worlds. You assume the form of spiritual perfection, O King of kings.

en.bdb: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||3||8||
en.ms: O my praiseworthy Lord, God, Master, Thou are ever just, true, abode of excellence and the primeval Person.
en.ssk: You are forever True, the Home of Excellence, the Primal Supreme Being. Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Guru, Waahay Jee-o. ||3||8||

en.bdb: He took birth in the Incarnations of the Fish, Tortoise and Wild Boar, and played His part. He played games on the banks of the Jamunaa River.
en.ms: Becoming the incarnation of the Big fish, Tortoise and the Boar, thou assumed their avocations. Such are Thou who played the game of "throw ball" at the bank of Jamuna.
en.ssk: He took birth in the Incarnations of the Fish, Tortoise and Wild Boar, and played His part. He played games on the banks of the Jamunaa River.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੀਏ ਧਾਰੁ ਤਜੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਗਯੰਦ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗੁਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੯॥

en.bdb: Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness of the mind, O Gayand the True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of the Universe Himself. ||4||9||
en.ms: Says Gayand, the bard, enshrine thou in thy heart his sublime Name and renounce thine mind's wickedness. The True Guru, the ever True Guru, the ever and ever True Guru is the embodiment of the World-Lord.
en.ssk: Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness of the mind, O Gayand the True Guru, the True Guru, the True Guru is the Lord of the Universe Himself. ||4||9||

en.bdb: Respect and obey the Guru's Word; this is your own personal treasure - know this mantra as true. Night and day, you shall be saved, and blessed with the supreme status.
en.ms: Know thou this instruction as true, obey thou the Guru's word, This alone is thy personal treasure, Thiswise thou shall be eternally emancipated and shall be blessed with the supreme status.
en.ssk: Respect and obey the Guru's Word; this is your own personal treasure - know this mantra as true. Night and day, you shall be saved, and blessed with the supreme status.

es.sn: Respeta y obedece la Palabra del Guru, este es tu propio y personal Tesoro, reconoce este Mantra como Verdad noche y día, y serás salvado y bendecido con el Estado de Éxtasis.

verse.unicode: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਣ ਜਣ ਸਿਉ ਛਾਡੁ ਧੋਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਾ ਫੰਧੁ ਕਾਟੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥

en.bdb: Renounce sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment; give up your games of deception. Snap the noose of egotism, and let yourself be at home in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
en.ms: Renounce thou lust, wrath, avarice and worldly love, give up deceiving one and all, snap the noose of self-conceit and be thou imbued with the saints' society.
en.ssk: Renounce sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment; give up your games of deception. Snap the noose of egotism, and let yourself be at home in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

es.sn: Renuncia a la lujuria, al enojo, a la avaricia y al apego, deja tus juegos de decepción, corta el dogal del egoísmo y deja que tu ser se sienta en casa en la Saad Sangat, la Compañía de los Santos.

en.bdb: Free your consciousness of attachment to your body, your home, your spouse, and the pleasures of this world. Serve forever at His Lotus Feet, and firmly implant these teachings within.
en.ms: Grasp thou this instruction in this world, abandon the love of thy body, home, wife and mind's revelments and ever serve the lotus feet to thy Guru.
en.ssk: Free your consciousness of attachment to your body, your home, your spouse, and the pleasures of this world. Serve forever at His Lotus Feet, and firmly implant these teachings within.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਰੁ ਹੀਏ ਧਾਰੁ ਤਜੁ ਬਿਕਾਰੁ ਮਨ ਗਯੰਦ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਿਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਤਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧੦॥

en.bdb: Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness of the mind, O Gayand. the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the True, Dear Lord. ||5||10||
en.ms: Says Gayand, the bard, enshrine thou in thy heart the sublime Name and renounce thine mind's wickedness. The venerable Guru, the highly venerable Guru, true is the most venerable Guru.
en.ssk: Enshrine this most excellent Name within your heart, and renounce the wickedness of the mind, O Gayand. the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the Supreme Guru, the True, Dear Lord. ||5||10||

en.ms: Uniting the elements together, Thou have created this great game and play of the word. O Wondrous Lord, all this is Thy creation.
en.ssk: You have formed and created this play, this great game. O Waahay Guru, this is all You, forever.

en.bdb: You are pervading and permeating the water, land, skies and nether regions; Your Words are sweeter than Ambrosial Nectar.
en.ms: Thou are fullyfilling the water, dry land, the firmament and the under-world. Such are thou, whose words are sweeter even than Nectar.
en.ssk: You are pervading and permeating the water, land, skies and nether regions; Your Words are sweeter than Ambrosial Nectar.

en.bdb: Brahmas and Shivas respect and obey You. O Death of death, Formless Lord, I beg of You.
en.ms: The Brahmas and the Shivas worship The. Thou are the death of death. O Immaculate Lord, every one begs of Thee.
en.ssk: Brahmas and Shivas respect and obey You. O Death of death, Formless Lord, I beg of You.

es.sn: Brahmas y Shivas Te respetan y obedecen, oh Muerte de muertes, Señor sin Forma Te Suplico.

en.bdb: By Guru's Grace, the greatest thing is obtained, and the mind is involved with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.
en.ms: By the Guru's grace, the supreme object is attained and the mind is absorbed in the saints' society.
en.ssk: By Guru's Grace, the greatest thing is obtained, and the mind is involved with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

es.sn: Por la Gracia del Guru, Lo más Grandioso es obtenido,

es.sn: Él es Hondo y Profundo, Insondable e Increíblemente Grandioso, Eternamente se desborda de todo tipo de Joyas.

en.bdb: The Saint-swans celebrate; their fear of death is erased, along with the accounts of their pain.
en.ms: The saint-swans make merry in the Guru's pool and their dread of death and the papers containing accounts of pains are destroyed.
en.ssk: The Saint-swans celebrate; their fear of death is erased, along with the accounts of their pain.

es.sn: Los Santos Cisnes celebran porque su temor a la muerte ha sido borrado junto con la cuenta de su dolor.

verse.unicode: ਕਲਜੁਗ ਦੁਰਤ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਬੇ ਕਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਗਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥੪॥

en.bdb: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the sins are taken away; the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan is the Ocean of all peace and comfort. ||4||
en.ms: In this Dark age, the holy vision of the Guru, the ocean of all comforts, rids the mortal of sins.
en.ssk: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the sins are taken away; the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan is the Ocean of all peace and comfort. ||4||

es.sn: En esta oscura Era de Kali los errores son descontados, la Bendita Visión del Darshan del Guru es el Océano de Paz y Bienestar. (4)

en.bdb: For His Sake, the silent sages meditated and focused their consciousness, wandering all the ages through; rarely, if ever, their souls were enlightened.
en.ms: For whose sake, fixing their attention, the sages wander through all the ages. Rare is the one, whose soul is sometimes illumined.
en.ssk: For His Sake, the silent sages meditated and focused their consciousness, wandering all the ages through; rarely, if ever, their souls were enlightened.

es.sn: Hacia Él, los Sabios silenciosos meditan y enfocan su Conciencia, vagando por todas las Épocas, alguna vez, sus Almas fueron Iluminadas.

en.bdb: In the Hymns of the Vedas, Brahma sang His Praises; for His Sake, Shiva the silent sage held his place on the Kailaash Mountain.
en.ms: Whose praise the Brahma sings with the Veda's hymns and for whose sake, the sage Shiva remains clung to the Kailash mountain (meditating).
en.ssk: In the Hymns of the Vedas, Brahma sang His Praises; for His Sake, Shiva the silent sage held his place on the Kailaash Mountain.

es.sn: En los himnos de los Vedas, Brahma cantó Sus Alabanzas, por Él Shiva, el Santo silencioso, mantuvo su aposento en la montaña de Kailash.

verse.unicode: ਜਾ ਕੌ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਤਪ ਜਟਾ ਜੂਟ ਭੇਖ ਕੀਏ ਫਿਰਤ ਉਦਾਸ ਕਉ ॥

en.bdb: For His Sake, the Yogis, celibates, Siddhas and seekers, the countless sects of fanatics with matted hair wear religious robes, wandering as detached renunciates.
en.ms: For whose sake wander dispassionately and wear religious garbs the yogis, celibates adepts, strivers and various penitents with matted hair.
en.ssk: For His Sake, the Yogis, celibates, Siddhas and seekers, the countless sects of fanatics with matted hair wear religious robes, wandering as detached renunciates.

es.sn: Por Él, los Yoguis, los célibes, los Siddhas y los buscadores, las incontables sectas de fanáticos, con su cabello engreñado, usan túnicas religiosas y vagan como renunciantes desapegados.

en.bdb: That True Guru, by the Pleasure of His Will, showered His Mercy upon all beings, and blessed Guru Raam Daas with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||5||
en.ms: That True Guru, through his pleasure, showed mercy to all the beings and blessed. Guru Ram Dass with the glory of the Name.
en.ssk: That True Guru, by the Pleasure of His Will, showered His Mercy upon all beings, and blessed Guru Raam Daas with the Glorious Greatness of the Naam. ||5||

en.bdb: He focuses His Meditation deep within; the Embodiment of Light, He illuminates the three worlds.
en.ms: The Guru, the Name's treasure, contemplates the Lord tuned to Him. He is the embodiment of Light and illumines the three worlds.
en.ssk: He focuses His Meditation deep within; the Embodiment of Light, He illuminates the three worlds.

en.ms: Seeing his vision, doubt, flees, forthwith pain is dispelled and peace easily wells up.
en.ssk: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, doubt runs away, pain is eradicated, and celestial peace spontaneously wells up.

es.sn: Teniendo la Bendita Visión de Su Darshan, la duda se aleja, el dolor es erradicado y la Paz Celestial es edificada de manera espontánea.

verse.unicode: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਸਦਾ ਅਤਿ ਲੁਭਿਤ ਅਲਿ ਸਮੂਹ ਜਿਉ ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਬਾਸੇ ॥

en.bdb: The selfless servants and Sikhs are always totally captivated by it, like bumble bees lured by the fragrance of the flower.
en.ms: Like the craving of all the black-bees for the fragrance of the flowers, the slavers and the disciples of the Guru, ever remain greatly fascinated by the Guru's sight.
en.ssk: The selfless servants and Sikhs are always totally captivated by it, like bumble bees lured by the fragrance of the flower.

es.sn: Los humildes Sirvientes y los Sikjs están siempre cautivados por Ello, como abejas atraídas por la fragancia de la flor.

en.bdb: The Guru Himself established the Eternal Throne of Truth, in Guru Raam Daas. ||6||
en.ms: The Guru his presence, himself, established the eternal and true throne of Guru Ram Dass.
en.ssk: The Guru Himself established the Eternal Throne of Truth, in Guru Raam Daas. ||6||

verse.gurmukhi: qwr´au sMswru mwXw md moihq AMimRq nwmu dIAau smrQu ]
verse.unicode: ਤਾਰੵਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਮਾਯਾ ਮਦ ਮੋਹਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਅਉ ਸਮਰਥੁ ॥

en.bdb: The Universe is intoxicated with the wine of Maya, but it has been saved; the All-powerful Guru has blessed it with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.
en.ms: Blessing it with the Name-Nectar, the Omnipotent Guru has emancipated the world, inebriated with the wine of mammon.
en.ssk: The Universe is intoxicated with the wine of Maya, but it has been saved; the All-powerful Guru has blessed it with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

es.sn: El Universo entero está embriagado con el vino de Maya, pero se ha salvado.

en.bdb: And, the Praiseworthy Guru is blessed with eternal peace, wealth and prosperity; the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhis never leave him.
en.ms: Again, the praise worthy Guru is ever blessed with peace and riches and prosperity and riches and prosperity and miraculous powers leave not His company.
en.ssk: And, the Praiseworthy Guru is blessed with eternal peace, wealth and prosperity; the supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhis never leave him.

es.sn: El Todopoderoso Guru lo ha bendecido con el Néctar Ambrosial del Naam y el Guru Digno de Alabanza es bendecido con Paz Eterna, riqueza y propiedades, y los Poderes Sobrenaturales de los Siddhis nunca lo dejan.

en.bdb: His Gifts are vast and great; His awesome Power is supreme. Your humble servant and slave speaks this truth.
en.ms: Great is the bounty of the Guru and he is blessed with the supremely great power. The slave Dass, the bard, recites this essence.

es.sn: Quienes meditan recordando al Guru Verdadero, la oscuridad de su mirada es removida en un sólo instante.

en.bdb: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru within their hearts, are blessed with the Lord's Name, day by day.
en.ms: Whosoever contemplates his True Guru, day by day, God's Name permeates his mind.
en.ssk: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru within their hearts, are blessed with the Lord's Name, day by day.

es.sn: Quienes meditan recordando al Verdadero Guru en su corazón, son bendecidos con el Nombre del Señor, día con día.

en.bdb: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru within their souls - the fire of desire is extinguished for them.
en.ms: Whosoever remembers the True Guru, the fire of his mind is quenched.
en.ssk: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru within their souls - the fire of desire is extinguished for them.

es.sn: Quienes meditan recordando al Verdadero Guru en su Alma, el fuego del deseo es extinguido en ellos.

en.ms: Whosoever remembers the True Guru, he is blest with wealth, miraculous powers and the nine treasures.
en.ssk: Those who meditate in remembrance on the True Guru, are blessed with wealth and prosperity, supernatural spiritual powers and the nine treasures.

es.sn: Quienes meditan recordando al Guru Verdadero, son bendecidos con Riqueza y Prosperidad, Poderes Sobrenaturales y los Nueve Tesoros. Así habla Baal, el poeta, Bendito sea Guru Ram Das, acercándose a la Saad Sangat,

en.bdb: So speaks BALL the poet: Blessed is Guru Raam Daas; joining the Sangat, the Congregation, call Him blessed and great.
en.ms: Such is Guru Ram Dass, says, Ball, the bard. Joining the saints' society, call him thou the blest, yea, the best indeed.
en.ssk: So speaks BALL the poet: Blessed is Guru Raam Daas; joining the Sangat, the Congregation, call Him blessed and great.

es.sn: la Congregación Lo llama Bendito y Grandioso. Mediten en el Verdadero Guru,

transliteration.ur: سوای رامداس گُر بلے بھݨ ملِ سںگت دھنّ دھںن کرهُ ۔۔

en.bdb: Meditate on the True Guru, O men, through Whom the Lord is obtained. ||5||54||
en.ms: O men, contemplate ye that True Guru, clinging to which True Guru, the Lord is obtained.
en.ssk: Meditate on the True Guru, O men, through Whom the Lord is obtained. ||5||54||

en.ms: Such is the Guru, who practising the name, attained the supreme status and whilst performing service, abandoned not the company of Guru Amar Dass.
en.ssk: Living the Word of the Shabad, He attained the supreme status; while performing selfless service, He did not leave the side of Guru Amar Daas.

en.bdb: From that service, the light from the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines forth, radiant and bright; it has destroyed pain, poverty and darkness.
en.ms: From that service, the light of the jewel of gnosis became manifest by which pain, poverty and darkness were destroyed.
en.ssk: From that service, the light from the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines forth, radiant and bright; it has destroyed pain, poverty and darkness.

en.bdb: So speaks Keerat the poet: those who grasp hold of the feet of the Saints, are not afraid of death, sexual desire or anger.
en.ms: Says Kirat, who cling to the feet of saints by turning away from the world, they dread not lust, wrath and death.
en.ssk: So speaks Keerat the poet: those who grasp hold of the feet of the Saints, are not afraid of death, sexual desire or anger.

verse.unicode: ਜਿਵ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤਿਵ ਗੁਰ ਅਮਰਦਾਸ ਕੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥੧॥

en.bdb: Just as Guru Nanak was part and parcel, life and limb with Guru Angad, so is Guru Amar Daas one with Guru Raam Daas. ||1||
en.ms: As Guru Nanak was always present with Angad, so abides Guru Amar, Dass with Guru Ram Dass.
en.ssk: Just as Guru Nanak was part and parcel, life and limb with Guru Angad, so is Guru Amar Daas one with Guru Raam Daas. ||1||

en.bdb: Gur Angad was with Him, life and limb, like the ocean; He showered His consciousness with the Word of the Shabad.
en.ms: From him became manifest, like the ocean, Angad, who ever lived in his presence. He rained the Lord's Name on the mortal's mind.
en.ssk: Gur Angad was with Him, life and limb, like the ocean; He showered His consciousness with the Word of the Shabad.

en.bdb: I am overflowing with sins and demerits; I have no merits or virtues at all. I abandoned the Ambrosial Nectar, and I drank poison instead.
en.ms: I am brimful with sins and have not even a single virtue. Abandoning Nectar, I eat nothing but poison.
en.ssk: I am overflowing with sins and demerits; I have no merits or virtues at all. I abandoned the Ambrosial Nectar, and I drank poison instead.

en.bdb: You are the Primal Lord God, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages; Your Power supports the three worlds.
en.ms: O Primeval person, Thou are since the commencement of ages and without any beginning. Thy power is giving support to the three worlds.
en.ssk: You are the Primal Lord God, from the very beginning, and throughout the ages; Your Power supports the three worlds.

en.bdb: You are Inaccessible; You are the Saving Grace of the Vedas. You have conquered old age and death.
en.ms: The Unfathomable Lord is the Saviour of the Vedas and he has conquered old age and death.
en.ssk: You are Inaccessible; You are the Saving Grace of the Vedas. You have conquered old age and death.

es.sn: Eres Inaccesible, eres la Gracia Salvadora de los Vedas y has conquistado la vejez y la muerte.

en.bdb: Guru Amar Daas has permanently established You; You are the Emancipator, to carry all across to the other side.
en.ms: Guru Amar Dass has eternally established thee. Thou are the emancipator of mortals and a ship to ferry across.
en.ssk: Guru Amar Daas has permanently established You; You are the Emancipator, to carry all across to the other side.

es.sn: Guru Amar Das Te ha establecido permanentemente, eres el Emancipador para cargarnos a todos hasta el otro lado.

en.bdb: So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, You are the Destroyer of sins; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||60||
en.ms: Says Sall, the poet, O Guru Ram Dass, thou are the destroyer of sins; therefore, I have sought Thine refuge.
en.ssk: So speaks SALL the poet: O Guru Raam Daas, You are the Destroyer of sins; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||2||60||

en.ssk: He is the Destroyer of fear, the Eradicator of the pains of others. Kall Sahaar the poet utters Your Praise, O Guru.

en.ms: In the lineage of Sodhis, Arjan the son of Guru Ram Dass, is born as the saint of God and he is the standard of piety.
en.ssk: In the Sodhi family, is born Arjun, the son of Guru Raam Daas, the holder of the banner of Dharma and the devotee of God. ||6||

en.bdb: Guru Arjun is the All-pervading Lord God of Mat'huraa. Devoted to His Worship, he remains attached to the Lord's Feet. ||3||
en.ms: Guru Arjan Dev, the Lord of Mathura, the bard, is the All-pervading God. For the sake of His meditation, he remains dedicated to the Lord's feet.
en.ssk: Guru Arjun is the All-pervading Lord God of Mat'huraa. Devoted to His Worship, he remains attached to the Lord's Feet. ||3||

en.ssk: Whoever meditates on Guru Arjun Dayv, shall not have to pass through the painful womb of reincarnation ever again. ||6||

verse.unicode: ਭਨਿ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਭੇਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਪਰਤਖੵ ਹਰਿ ॥੭॥੧੯॥

en.bdb: So speaks Mat'huraa: there is no difference between God and Guru; Guru Arjun is the Personification of the Lord Himself. ||7||19||
en.ms: Says Mathura, there is no distinction between the Guru and God. Guru Arjan is manifestly the Lord himself.
en.ssk: So speaks Mat'huraa: there is no difference between God and Guru; Guru Arjun is the Personification of the Lord Himself. ||7||19||

es.sn: Así habla Mathura, no hay diferencia entre Dios y el Guru, Guru Aryan es la Personificación del Señor Mismo. (7-19)

en.bdb: The stream of the Lord's Name flows like the Ganges, invincible and unstoppable. The Sikhs of the Sangat all bathe in it.
en.ms: Unconquerable and unfailing is water of the Guru's Ganges. His disciples and congregation all bathe therein.
en.ssk: The stream of the Lord's Name flows like the Ganges, invincible and unstoppable. The Sikhs of the Sangat all bathe in it.

es.sn: El Arroyo del Nombre del Señor fluye como el Ganges, Invencible e Imparable. Los Sikjs de la Sangat se bañan ahí.

en.bdb: It appears as if the holy texts like the Puraanaas are being recited there and Brahma himself sings the Vedas.
en.ms: The Puranas ever dwell upon the Guru and Brahma too with his mouth sings his praise through his Vedas.
en.ssk: It appears as if the holy texts like the Puraanaas are being recited there and Brahma himself sings the Vedas.

es.sn: Parece como si los Textos de los Puranas están siendo recitados ahí y el Mismo Brahma recita el canto de los Vedas.

verse.unicode: ਅਜੈ ਚਵਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਢੁਲੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੀਅਉ ॥

en.bdb: The invincible chauri, the fly-brush, waves over His head; with His mouth, He drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.
en.ms: Over his head waves invincible fly brush and with his mouth he quaffs the Name-Nectar.
en.ssk: The invincible chauri, the fly-brush, waves over His head; with His mouth, He drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

es.sn: El Chauri Invencible, el espanta moscas, hondea sobre Su Cabeza. Con Su boca Él bebe el Néctar Ambrosial del Naam.

en.ms: The Transcendent Lord Himself has placed the royal canopy over the head of Guru Arjan Dev.
en.ssk: The Transcendent Lord Himself has placed the royal canopy over the head of Guru Arjun.

ft.unicode: ਰਸਕ ਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਅਰੁ ਸਭਾ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਸ ਕਾਬ੍ਯ ਕੇ ਗ੍ਰੰਥੋਂ ਮੇਂ ਚਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਲਿਖਾ ਹੈ ੧ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਮੂਰਤੀ, ੨ ਸੁਪਨ, ੩ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ, ੪ ਪ੍ਰਤੱਖ ਦਰਸਨੁ। ਈਹਾਂ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣ ਵਾ ਮੂਰਤੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇ ਬਿਨਾ ਪਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਮੇਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਉਪਜਤੀ, ਤਾਂ ਤੇ ਇਨ ਦਰਸਨੋਂ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੀ ਬਿਨਾ (ਅੰਧਾ) ਅਗ੍ਯਾਨੀ ਜੀਵ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ, ਵਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਉਪਜੇ ਸੇ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਹ ਕੋ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇਖੇਗਾ, ਐਸੇ ਪਦਛੇਦ ਕਰ ਲੈਣਾ॥☬ਨਨੂ: ਜੋ ਅਗ੍ਯਾਨੀ ਹੋਗਾ ਤਿਸ ਕੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਾਦਿਕੋਂ ਕੀ ਅਪੇਖ੍ਯਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੋਗੀ? ਆਪ ਕੇ ਕਥਨ ਸੇ ਐਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਤਿ ਹੋਤਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੇ, ਤਬ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਾਦਿਕੋਂ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ?☬ਉੱਤਰ: ਹਮਾਰੇ ਕਥਨ ਕਾ ਭਾਵ ਯਹਿ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਸਾਮਾਨ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਹੋਤਾ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਤਿਸਤੇ ਅਨੰਤ੍ਰ ਸ੍ਰਵਣਾਦਿਕ ਹੋਤੇ ਹੈਂ। ਜੈਸੇ ਵੈਸਨਵ ਮਤਿ ਮੇਂ ਪ੍ਰਿਥਮ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਹੋ ਲੇਵੇ ਤਬ ਪੀਛੇ ਸੇ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾ ਹੋਨਾ ਮਾਨਤੇ ਹੈਂ।

ft.unicode: ਸੋ ਹਰੀ ਜਿਸ ਕੋ ਦ੍ਯਾਲ ਹੋਤ ਹੈ, ਸੋ ਪੁਰਸ਼ ਹਰੀ ਨਾਮ ਕੋ ਜਪ ਕਰ ਕੇ (ਭਉ) ਡਰ ਰੂਪੀ (ਬਿਖਮੁ) ਕਠਨ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋ ਤਰ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੈ ॥੧॥ ਪਾਕਪਟਣ ਕੇ ਨਿਕਟ ਏਕ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸੇ ਬਾਹਰ ਫਰੀਦ ਕੇ ਪੋਤੇ ਸੇਖ ਬਹਿਰਾਮ ਸੰਜੁਗਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੁਛ ਕੁਛ ਅੰਤਰੇ ਸਹਤ ਸੋਏ ਪੜੇ ਥੇ। ਏਕ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੀ ਜਨ ਦੂਧ ਲੇ ਕਰ ਆਇਆ। ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਸੋਏ ਹੂਏ ਜਾਨ ਕਰ ਏਕ ਗੜਵਾ ਦੂਧ ਕਾ ਬੀਚ ਏਕ ਅਸ਼ਰਫੀ ਪਾਸ ਰਖ ਕਰ ਸੇਖ ਬਹਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਦੂਧ ਪਿਲਾ ਕਰ ਚਲਾ ਗਿਆ। ਸੇਖ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੋ ਗੜਵੇ ਕੀ ਖਬਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਥੀ। ਜਬ ਆਪਸ ਮੇਂ ਮਿਲ ਕਰ ਬੈਠੇ ਤਬ ਬਲਾਸ ਸੇ ਸੇਖ ਬਹਰਾਮ ਨੇ ਕਹਾ, 'ਸੋਣੇ ਸੇ ਜਾਗਣੇ ਮੇਂ ਬਹੁਤ ਲਾਭ ਹੈ, ਹਮ ਦੂਧ ਪੀਆ ਆਪ ਕੋ ਮਿਲਾ ਨਹੀਂ'। ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਨੇ ਅਸ਼ਰਫੀ ਸਹਤ ਦੂਧ ਕਾ ਗੜਵਾ ਦਿਖਲਾਇ ਕਰ ਸਲੋਕ ਉਚਾਰਨ ਕੀਆ॥

ft.unicode: ਏਕ ਪੁਰਸ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤ ਕੋ ਜਾਗਤੇ ਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਤੇ ਹੈਂ, ਔਰ ਏਕ ਸੋਏ ਹੂਏ ਪੁਰਸੋਂ ਕੋ ਉਠਾ ਕਰ ਦੇ ਦੇਤਾ ਹੈ। ਭਾਵ ਏਹਿ ਕਿ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਗਤੇ ਥੇ ਆਪ ਕੋ ਅਸ਼ਰਫੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲੀ, ਹਮ ਸੌਣੇ ਵਾਲਿਓਂ ਨੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੇ ਅਸ਼ਰਫੀ ਦੂਧ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ਪਾ ਲਈ। ਸਿਧਾਂਤ ਮੇਂ ਪਹਲੀ ਤੁਕ ਕਾ ਅਰਥ ਤੌ ਵਹੀ ਰਹਾ ਦੂਸਰੀ ਕਾ ਔਰ ਕਹਤੇ ਹੈਂ। ਏਕ ਪੰਡਤ ਸਾਸਤ੍ਰੋਂ ਮੇਂ ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਕੀ ਦਾਤ ਕੋ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਤੇ ਹੈਂ, ਇਕਨਾ (ਸੁਤਿਆ) ਮੂਰਖਤਾ ਮੇਂ ਇਸਥਿਤ ਹੋਇਆਂ ਕੋ ਉਠਾਲਿ ਕੇ, ਕਿਆ ਮੂਰਖਤਾ ਸੇ ਰਹਤ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਸਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੀ ਕਰ ਦੇਤਾ ਹੈ। ਵਾ (ਇਕ ਜਾਗੰਦੇ) ਏਕ ਅਵਿਦ੍ਯਾ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਸੇ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਮੇਂ ਜਾਗੇ ਹੂਏ ਅਗ੍ਯਾਨੀ ਤੋ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਕੇ (ਨਾਲ ਹਨ) ਸਾਥ ਹੀ ਅਭੇਦ ਹੈਂ, ਇਕਨਾਂ ਸੁਤਿਆਂ ਹੋਇਆਂ ਕੋ ਅਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਨੀਂਦ ਸੇ ਜਗਾਇ ਕਰ ਅਕਸ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਸੇ ਅਪਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੀ ਦੇਤਾ ਹੈ॥੧॥☬ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਸੇਖ ਬਹਿਰਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਅਬ ਤੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਕੇ ਪੁਰਸ ਕਹਤੇ ਹੈਂ:

ft.unicode: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕਹਤੇ ਹੈਂ: ਤੌ ਹੀ ਪਤ ਕੋ (ਪਰੁ) ਵਸੇਸ ਕਰ ਕੇ (ਜਾਪੈ) ਜਾਣੀਐ, ਜੋ ਪਰਮੇਸ੍ਵਰ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੇਂ ਪਾ ਲੇਵੇ॥੧॥☬ਜਬ ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਜੀ ਗੁਰਿਆਈ ਕੋ ਪਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਖਡੂਰ ਮੇਂ ਆਇ ਕਰ, ਅਰ ਕੋਠੇ ਕਾ ਬਾਰ ਬੰਦ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਸਮਾਧੀ ਮੇਂ ਇਸਥਿਤ ਹੂਏ ਥੇ। ਤਬ ਭਾਈ ਬਾਲਾ ਔਰ ਬੁਢਾ ਜੀ ਆਦਿ ਸਿਖ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੋ ਆਏ। ਬੁਢੇ ਜੀ ਨੇ ਬਾਰ ਖੋਲ ਕਰ ਚਰਨੋਂ ਪਰ ਸੀਸ ਰਖਾ। ਗੁਰੂ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਚਲਾਨੇ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਸੁਨ ਕਰ ਕੇ, ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮੇਂ ਅਪਨੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤੀ ਸੂਚਨ ਕਰਾਵਤੇ ਹੂਏ ਵਿਜੋਗ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਲੋਕ ਉਚਾਰਨ ਕੀਆ:

ft.unicode: ਔਰ ਵਹੁ ਆਤਮਾਨੰਦੀ ਪੁਰਸ ਆਪ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਬੰਧਨੋਂ ਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਰ ਸਹਤ ਛੂਟੇ ਹੈਂ, ਪੁਨਾ ਤਿਨੋਂ ਕੇ ਪੀਛੇ ਸਭ ਜਗਤ ਛੁਟ ਜਾਤਾ ਹੈ। ਭਾਵ ਏਹਿ ਕਿ ਜੋ ਉਨ ਕੇ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਹੈਂ, ਸੋ ਉਨ ਕੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸੇ ਸੁਭ ਮਾਰਗ ਮੇਂ ਪ੍ਰਵਿਰਤ ਹੋ ਕਰ ਗ੍ਯਾਨ ਕੋ ਪਾਇ ਕਰ ਛੁਟੇ ਹੈਂ, ਔਰ ਜੋ ਜਗ੍ਯਾਸਾ ਧਾਰ ਕਰ ਸਰਣ ਆਵਤੇ ਹੈਂ, ਸੋ ਭੀ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪੀਛੇ ਜਗਤ ਸੇ ਛੁਟ ਜਾਤੇ ਹੈਂ॥੩॥☬ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ ਪਾਸ ਏਕ ਕਾਜੀ ਨੇ ਨਿਮ੍ਰਤਾ ਸਹਤ ੬ ਪ੍ਰਸ਼ਨ ਕੀਏ ਹੈਂ ਕਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ, ਖੁਦਾ ਨੇ ਉਮਤ ਕੈਸੇ ਪੈਦਾ ਕਰੀ ਹੈ ੧, ਔਰ ਖੁਦਾ ਕੇ ਬੰਦਿਓਂ ਕਾ ਲਖਣ ਕਿਆ ਹੈ ੨, ਖੁਦਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤ ਕਿਸੀ ਨੇ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਯਾ ਨਹੀਂ ੩, ਜੇ ਕਰ ਪਾਈ ਹੈ ਤਬ ਵਹੁ ਕੇਤੀਕ ਹੈ ੪, ਸ਼ਰਾ ਵਾਲੇ ਤੋ ਸ਼ਰਾ ਮੇਂ ਰਹਣਾ ਸ੍ਰੇਸਟ ਮਾਨਤੇ ਹੈਂ, ਸ਼ਰਾ ਸੇ ਖੁਦਾ ਕੋ ਪਾਵਤੇ ਹੈਂ ਯਾ ਨਹੀਂ ੫, ਵਹੁ ਸਿਜਦਾ ਕੌਣ ਸਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਕਰ ਜੀਵ ਖੁਦਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਦੇਖ ਲੇਵੇ ੬? ਕ੍ਰਮ ਪੂਰਬਕ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਉੱਤਰ ਦੇਤੇ ਹੈਂ:

ft.unicode: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕਹਤੇ ਹੈਂ: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੋਂਦ੍ਵਾਰਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲਤੇ ਹੈਂ, ਸੋ ਦੁਖੋਂ ਸੇ ਬਚੇ ਹੈਂ॥੧॥☬ਕਦਲੀ ਬਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਆ ਰਾਜ ਏਕ ਦੇਸ ਹੈ। ਵਹਾਂ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ ਬਾਲੇ ਮਰਦਾਨੇ ਸਹਿਤ ਪਹੁੰਚੇ। ਮਰਦਾਨੇ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਭੂਖ ਲਗੀ ਹੈ ਹੁਕਮ ਹੋ ਤੌ ਨਗਰ ਮੇਂ ਭੋਜਨ ਪਾਇ ਆਊਂ। ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਰੋਕਨੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਰੁਕਾ। ਜਬ ਸ਼ਹਰ ਮੇਂ ਗਯਾ ਤਬ ਇਕ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਨੇ ਕੌਤਕ ਕੇ ਵਾਸਤੇ ਗਲ ਮੇਂ ਤਾਗਾ ਬਾਂਧ ਕਰ ਭੇਡਾ ਬਨਾਇ ਬਾਂਧ ਰਖਾ। ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਨੇ ਕਹਾ ਕਿ ਹੇ ਬਾਲੇ ਮਰਦਾਨਾ ਭੇਡਾ ਬਨਾ ਹੂਆ ਹੈ। ਬਾਲੇ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਨੇ ਸੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਨੇ ਸਹਰ ਮੇਂ ਜਾ ਕਰ ਬਾਲੇ ਕੋ ਹੁਕਮ ਦੀਆ ਕਿ ਤੂੰ  ਇਸ ਕੇ ਗਲੇ ਕਾ ਤੰਤ ਤੋੜ ਦੇ। ਜਬ ਤੰਤ ਤੋੜੀ ਤਬ ਮਰਦਾਨੇ ਨੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਮਥਾ ਟੇਕਿਆ। ਔਰ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀਆਂ ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਔਰ ਬਾਲੇ ਕੇ ਤੰਤ ਬਾਂਧਨੇ ਆਈਂ ਥੀਂ, ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਥੀ ਤੈਸੀ ਹੀ ਬੰਦ ਹੋ ਗਈ। ਕਿਸੀ ਕੇ ਸਿਰ ਪਰ ਘੜਾ ਹੈ, ਕੋਈ ਪੀਹੜੀ ਪਰ ਹੀ ਬੈਠੀ ਜਮ ਗਈ, ਏਹੁ ਸਭ ਹਾਲ ਸਹਰ ਮੇਂ ਸੁਨਾ ਗਿਆ। ਵਹਾਂ ਕੀ ਹਾਕਮ ਨੂਰ ਸਾਹ ਨਾਮ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਥੀ। ਵਹੁ ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਕੇ ਚਰਨੀ ਪੜੀ ਔਰ ਅਵੱਗ੍ਯਾ ਬਖਸਾਈ। ਤਹਾਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀ ਨੇ ਧਰਮਸਾਲ ਬਨਵਾਈ। ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਥਾਇ ਸਲੋਕ ਉਚਾਰਨ ਕੀਆ:

en.ms: O perverse person! bereft of Lord's Name, go not astray by beholding the colour of the safflower.
en.ssk: O self-willed manmukh, devoid of the Naam, do not be misled upon beholding the color of the safflower.

en.ms: It's colour will last a few days and paltry is its price.
en.ssk: Its color lasts for only a few days-it is worthless!

en.bdb: Attached to duality, the foolish, blind and stupid people waste away and die.
en.ms: Through attachment to duality, the foolish, blind and stupid persons putrefy to death.
en.ssk: Attached to duality, the foolish, blind and stupid people waste away and die.

en.bdb: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are dyed in the color of truth; they take on the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.
en.ms: Nanak, they who are imbued with the Name and are happy and take on the Guru's state of equipoise.
en.ssk: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are dyed in the color of truth; they take on the intuitive peace and poise of the Guru.

en.ssk: You created the entire universe, and You Yourself bring sustenance to it.

es.sn: Tú, oh Señor, creaste el Universo y le diste sustancia a todo.

en.ms: Some eat by practising deceit and fraud, and from their mouth they drop falsehood and untruth.
en.ssk: Some eat and survive by practicing fraud and deceit; from their mouths they drop falsehood and lies.

es.sn: Algunos viven de mañas y no hablan más que falsedades.

en.ms: Thou hast put them to that task and they do that very work which pleaseth Thine own self.
en.ssk: As it pleases You, You assign them their tasks.

es.sn: Ésta también es Tú Voluntad, pues Tú los involucraste en esa tarea.

en.ms: To some Thou has explained truthfulness, and to them Thou hast given inexhaustible treasures there-of.
en.ssk: Some understand Truthfulness; they are given the inexhaustible treasure.

es.sn: Algunos realizan la Verdad y reciben el Tesoro Ilimitado del Nombre del Señor.

verse.unicode: ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਅਚੇਤਾ ਹਥ ਤਡਾਇਆ ॥੮॥

en.bdb: Those who eat by remembering the Lord are prosperous, while those who do not remember Him stretch out their hands in need. ||8||
en.ms: Profitable is the advent of those who eat by remembering God. They, who remember not the Lord, stretch out their hand to beg.
en.ssk: Those who eat by remembering the Lord are prosperous, while those who do not remember Him stretch out their hands in need. ||8||

en.ms: He never think of him who gave him the soul and body and who provides all with sustenance.
en.ssk: They never think of the One who gave them body and soul, who provides sustenance to all.

en.ssk: The blind, self-willed manmukhs do not understand anything. They do what they are pre-ordained to do.

es.sn: A través de la Palabra del Guru realizo mi ser, y a mi interior llega la Luz del Nombre del Señor.

en.bdb: The true ones practice Truth; greatness rests in the Great Lord.
en.ms: The true man practises truth. The greatness is with the great Lord.
en.ssk: The true ones practice Truth; greatness rests in the Great Lord.

es.sn: Practiqué la Verdad, pero la Gloria está en las manos del Gran Señor.

transliteration.english: sacho sach kamaavanaa vaddiaaiee vadde paas ||

en.bdb: Body, soul and all things belong to the Lord-praise Him, and offer your prayers to Him.
en.ms: He glorifies and supplicates the Lord, to whom belong his soul, body and everything.
en.ssk: Body, soul and all things belong to the Lord-praise Him, and offer your prayers to Him.

ss.gurmukhi: ijMd qy srIr sB kuJ pRBU dw (jwx ky auh pRBU A`gy) bynqI qy is&iq-swlwh krdw hY

es.sn: Él es el cuerpo y la vida, yo le alabo y le rezo a Él.

transliteration.english: jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tis kaa sifat kare aradhaas ||
transliteration.hindi: जीउ पिंडु सभु तिस का सिफति करे अरदासि ॥

verse.unicode: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਸੁਖੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥

en.bdb: Sing the Praises of the True Lord through the Word of His Shabad, and you shall abide in the peace of peace.
en.ms: By singing the praises of the true lord, he abides in supreme bliss.
en.ssk: Sing the Praises of the True Lord through the Word of His Shabad, and you shall abide in the peace of peace.

ss.gurmukhi: Sbd dI rwhIN auh sdw-iQr pRBU dI is&iq krdw hY, qy hr vyly Awqmk AwnMd ivc lIn rihMdw hY

bdb.gurmukhi: Sbd dI rwhIN auh sdw-iQr pRBU dI is&iq krdw hY, qy hr vyly Awqmk AwnMd ivc lIn rihMdw hY
bdb.unicode: ਸ਼ਬਦ ਦੀ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਉਹ ਸਦਾ-ਥਿਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤੇ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਆਨੰਦ ਵਿਚ ਲੀਨ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ

es.sn: Por medio de la Alabanza del Señor, a través de la Palabra, uno habita en la Paz Eterna.

transliteration.english: sachai sabadh saalaahanaa sukhe sukh nivaas ||
transliteration.hindi: सचै सबदि सालाहणा सुखे सुखि निवासु ॥
transliteration.en: sachai sabadh saalaahanaa sukhe sukh nivaas ||

verse.gurmukhi: jpu qpu sMjmu mnY mwih ibnu nwvY iDRgu jIvwsu ]
verse.unicode: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਮਨੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਸੁ ॥

en.bdb: You may practice chanting, penance and austere self-discipline within your mind, but without the Name, life is useless.
en.ms: Within his mind, though man may practises recitation, penance and self-restraint, yet without God's Name, accursed is his living.
en.ssk: You may practice chanting, penance and austere self-discipline within your mind, but without the Name, life is useless.

es.sn: Toda penitencia, toda meditación, toda disciplina está en la mente; sin el Nombre del Señor en la mente, desgraciada es la vida de uno.

transliteration.english: jap tap sa(n)jam manai maeh bin naavai dhirag jeevaas ||
transliteration.hindi: जपु तपु संजमु मनै माहि बिनु नावै धृगु जीवासु ॥

transliteration.hi: जपु तपु संजमु मनै माहि बिनु नावै धृगु जीवासु ॥
transliteration.ipa: d͡ʒəp t̪əp səŋd͡ʒəm mənæ mɑh bɪn nɑʋæ t̪ɪɹəG d͡ʒiʋɑs.
transliteration.ur: جپ تپ سںجم منَے ماه بن ناوَے دھرگ جیِواس ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: gurmqI nwau pweIAY mnmuK moih ivxwsu ]
verse.unicode: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥

en.bdb: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained, while the self-willed manmukh wastes away in emotional attachment.
en.ms: By Guru's instruction, Lord's Name is received. The self-willed perish through worldly love.
en.ssk: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained, while the self-willed manmukh wastes away in emotional attachment.

ms.unicode: ਗੁਰਾਂ ਦੇ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਆਪ-ਹੁੰਦਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਮਮਤਾ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਨਾਸ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।

es.sn: A través de la Palabra del Guru, recibimos el Nombre, los arrogantes Manmukjs desperdician su vida en el apego.

transliteration.english: gurmatee naau paieeaai manmukh moh vinaas ||
transliteration.hindi: गुरमती नाउ पाईऐ मनमुख मोहि विणासु ॥
transliteration.en: gurmatee naau paieeaai manmukh moh vinaas ||
transliteration.hi: गुरमती नाउ पाईऐ मनमुख मोहि विणासु ॥
transliteration.ipa: Gʊrəmət̪i nɑo pɑeiæ mənəmʊkʰ mɔh ʋɪɳɑs.
transliteration.ur: گُرمتیِ ناا پاایاَے منمکھ موه وݨاس ۔۔

verse.gurmukhi: ijau BwvY iqau rwKu qUM nwnku qyrw dwsu ]2]

en.bdb: Please protect me, by the Pleasure of Your Will. Nanak is Your slave. ||2||

en.ms: All are thine, O lord! and thou belongest to all. Thou art the capital of everyone.
en.ssk: All are Yours, and You belong to all. You are the wealth of all.

es.sn: Todos son Tuyos, oh Dios, Tú perteneces a todos, eres el Tesoro de todos.

en.ms: All beg of Thee for alms and each day make supplication.
en.ssk: Everyone begs from You, and all offer prayers to You each day.

en.bdb: Those, unto whom You give, receive everything. You are far away from some, and You are close to others.
en.ms: Whomsoever Thou givest, he obtains every thing. To some Thou art distant and to some near.
en.ssk: Those, unto whom You give, receive everything. You are far away from some, and You are close to others.

es.sn: A quien sea que bendices lo obtiene todo, para algunos estás muy cerca y para otros estás muy lejos.

en.bdb: Without You, there is not even a place to stand begging. See this yourself and verify it in your mind.
en.ms: Without Thee, there is no place where to beg from. Let some one verify and see in his mind.
en.ssk: Without You, there is not even a place to stand begging. See this yourself and verify it in your mind.

es.sn: No hay otro lugar en ningún lado para preguntar; velo por ti misma, oh, mi mente.

en.ssk: That person, with whom the Lord is pleased, meets with the Guru, and meditates on the Name of the Lord.

es.sn: Aquél que obtiene la Gracia del Señor, encuentra al Guru, y sólo él habita en el Nombre del Señor.

en.ms: By Guru's words, God is obtained, and the Lord ferries the man across the world-ocean.

en.ssk: Through stubborn-mindedness, none have found Him; go and consult the Vedas on this.

es.sn: Dice Nanak, el Esclavo del Señor, vive cantando su Nombre y si pasara aunque sea un instante sin Él, moriría. (2)

en.bdb: One who is accepted at the Court of the Lord shall be accepted in courts everywhere.
en.ms: He, who repairs to God's court, is accepted at all the courts.
en.ssk: One who is accepted at the Court of the Lord shall be accepted in courts everywhere.

es.sn: Aquél que medita en la Corte del Señor, es aceptado en todas las cortes.

verse.gurmukhi: ijQY Ehu jwie iqQY Ehu surKrU aus kY muih ifTY sB pwpI qirAw ]
verse.unicode: ਜਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਸੁਰਖਰੂ ਉਸ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਸਭ ਪਾਪੀ ਤਰਿਆ ॥

en.bdb: Wherever he goes, he is recognized as honorable. Seeing his face, all sinners are saved.
en.ms: Wherever he goes, he stands exonerated there. By seeing his face all the sinners are saved.
en.ssk: Wherever he goes, he is recognized as honorable. Seeing his face, all sinners are saved.

ss.gurmukhi: ijQy auh jWdw hY, auQy hI aus dw m`Qw iKiVAw rihMdw hY, aus dw mUMh vyK ky (Bwv, aus dw drSn kr ky) sB pwpI qr jWdy hn

es.sn: Donde sea que él habita, ahí se ve bello, aun aquéllos que traicionaron a su propio ser fueron salvados al mirar sus ojos.

transliteration.en: jithai oh jai tithai oh surakharoo us kai muh ddiThai sabh paapee tariaa ||
transliteration.hi: जिथै ओहु जाइ तिथै ओहु सुरखरू उस कै मुहि डिठै सभ पापी तरिआ ॥

en.bdb: Within him is the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Through the Naam, he is exalted.
en.ms: Within him is the Name treasure, and through God's Name he becomes acceptable.
en.ssk: Within him is the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. Through the Naam, he is exalted.

es.sn: En él vive el Tesoro del Nombre del Señor, de Aquél que lo vuelve glorioso.

en.bdb: He worships the Name, and believes in the Name; the Name erases all his sinful mistakes.
en.ms: The Name he adores, the Name he believes in and God's Name effaces all his sins.
en.ssk: He worships the Name, and believes in the Name; the Name erases all his sinful mistakes.

es.sn: Alaba entonces el Nombre del Señor, cree en Él, y tus faltas serán canceladas,

es.sn: Sin el Guru, uno no puede lograr la Paz Eterna y la mugre de la avaricia no es lavada en el interior.

en.bdb: If the Lord's Name abides within the mind, for a moment, even for an instant, it is like bathing at all the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
en.ms: If God's Name dwells in the mind even for an instant and a movement, it includes bathing at all the sixty-eight place of pilgrimage.
en.ssk: If the Lord's Name abides within the mind, for a moment, even for an instant, it is like bathing at all the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.

es.sn: Si el Nombre del Señor llega a tu mente, incluso por un instante, eso te da más mérito que irte a bañar a los sesenta y ocho lugares santos.

en.bdb: Filth does not stick to those who are true, but filth attaches itself to those who love duality.
en.ms: To the True, filth attaches not. Impurity attaches to him who harbours love for duality.
en.ssk: Filth does not stick to those who are true, but filth attaches itself to those who love duality.

es.sn: Cuando uno habita en la Verdad, uno no es manchado, es en la dualidad que la mugre se pega.

en.ms: By washing, it never departs though one may have ablutions at sixty-eight shrines.
en.ssk: This filth cannot be washed off, even by bathing at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
